The accepted inputs are still unchanged on disk, and my earlier callback is bound verbatim in `execution-acceptance.json` — note hash `388f2386`, 3494 chars, including my nits and the thin-headroom figure. The publish log is structurally exactly what the accepted script emits, and under `set -e` the single `PUBLISHED` line can only print after the post-upgrade image, version, JS and Reader checks all passed.
